Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing assessments for nuisance abatement in cities and towns.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to assessments for nuisance abatement in cities andtowns; adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW; and adding a newsection to chapter 35A.21 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A city or town may declare by ordinance what is deemed to be anuisance within the city or town, including but not limited to "litter"and "potentially dangerous litter" as defined in RCW 70.93.030;prevent, remove, and abate a nuisance at the expense of the partiescreating, causing, or committing the nuisance; and levy a specialassessment on the land or premises on which the nuisance is situated todefray the cost, or to reimburse the city or town for the cost ofabating it. This assessment shall constitute a lien against theproperty, which shall be of equal rank with state, county, andmunicipal taxes.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A city may declare by ordinance what is deemed to be a nuisancewithin the city, including but not limited to "litter" and "potentiallydangerous litter" as defined in RCW 70.93.030; prevent, remove, andabate a nuisance at the expense of the parties creating, causing, orcommitting the nuisance; and levy a special assessment on the land orpremises on which the nuisance is situated to defray the cost, or toreimburse the city for the cost of abating it. This assessment shallconstitute a lien against the property, which shall be of equal rankwith state, county, and municipal taxes.
